note: Adapted from the English original of Bourguignon et al. (2008); new species (sp. nov.), the diagnostic characters being the Diagnosis of the original. Measurements follow TABLE 16 (5 male and 1 female alates) and TABLE 17 (5 soldiers), the parenthetical values being the single female values of the second column. In TABLE 17 the maximum postmentum width is printed in the original as 0.50–055, with one decimal point missing, and is entered here as 0.50–0.55 mm. TABLE 18 lists head width only for the worker, the other worker measurements not being listed. Locality, type specimens, specimens examined and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This species is most similar to P. schultzei (P. cf. schultzei in the original), from which it differs in the longer, more densely hairy soldier head capsule and in the more heavily armed worker enteric valve.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body medium to large. Head capsule 2 times as long as wide, with setae of medium length, the pilosity of medium density. Frons flat. Labrum very short, with several setae. Right mandible large, its apex not pointed. Postmentum narrow and long, its maximum width about 2.5 times its minimum width. Antennae 14-segmented. Body with moderate pilosity throughout. Measurements (5 soldiers of the type colony): head length to anterolateral corner of gena 3.04–3.28 mm, head depth including postmentum 1.34–1.44 mm, maximum head width 1.59–1.68 mm, head width at the anterolateral corner of the gena 1.34–1.44 mm, right mandible length 1.79–1.92 mm, left mandible length 2.03–2.10 mm, maximum postmentum width 0.50–0.55 mm, minimum postmentum width 0.18–0.23 mm, pronotal width 0.83–0.90 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Enteric valve well developed, the surface of each cushion bearing about 15 well-sclerotized triangular spines. Measurements: head width 1.077–1.181 mm (10 workers from 1 colony).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule with many small setae and about 20 long setae. Compound eyes large. Ocelli large, close to the compound eye but not touching it. Antennae 15-segmented. Pronotum and body with numerous setae. Measurements (5 males and 1 female from the type colony; parenthetical values for the female): body length with wings 12.3–13.3 mm (13.5), body length without wings 6.06–6.85 mm (6.88), head length to apex of labrum 1.36–1.53 mm (1.43), head length to frontoclypeal suture 0.76–0.88 mm (0.81), head width including compound eyes 1.26–1.37 mm (1.30), maximum diameter of compound eye 0.31–0.41 mm (0.35), maximum length of ocellus 0.16–0.22 mm (0.19), pronotal length 0.55–0.63 mm (0.54), pronotal width 0.99–1.15 mm (1.04), forewing length 11.0–12.1 mm (11.8), forewing width 2.80–3.02 mm (3.00).
